attractions.name: Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura
attractions.description: A history theme park highlighting the Edo Period, one of the most attractive eras in Japanese history. Step back in time to enjoy traditional games, activities, theaters and street performances. Mingle with the Ninja and Oiran courtesans symbolic of the Edo Period.

attractions.name: Noboribetsu Jigokudani
attractions.description: A spectacular valley just above the town of Noboribetsu Onsen, displaying hot steam vents, sulfurous streams and other volcanic activity.

attractions.name: Mt. Showa-Shinzan
attractions.description: Literally 'Showa new mountain', formed during the reign of Emperor Hirohito, known as the Showa period.

attractions.name: Noboribetsu Marine Park Nixe
attractions.description: A popular theme park focusing on fish, marine mammals, sea creatures and other animals. Includes a touch pool with small sharks, rays and horseshoe crabs, and a reptile house with snakes, turtles and lizards. Activities and events such as the Parade of the king penguins (subject to weather).

attractions.name: Otaru Canal
attractions.description: Rows of old stone warehouses stand along the canal, with a stone-paved promenade and old-fashioned gas lamps that give a romantic atmosphere.

attractions.name: Sakaimachi Street
attractions.name_zh: 堺町通 / 音乐风铃馆
attractions.description: An attractive preserved merchant street in central Otaru, famous for Kitaichi Glass and the Music Box Museum (3,000+ antique and modern music boxes per the Chinese text).

attractions.name: Shiroi Koibito Park
attractions.description: A space themed on sweets from a bygone era. Houses the Shiroi Koibito Factory (well-known Hokkaido confectionery), a cafe for Ishiya's original sweets (self-paid per Chinese text), the Cookie Craft Studio, a toy exhibition room and the Rose Garden.

attractions.name: Hokkaido Shrine
attractions.description: In 1869 the Meiji Emperor decided to enshrine three Shinto deities: Sukunahikona, Okunitama and Okuninushi, who became the three deities of Hokkaido. The shrine was built in 1871 and first called 'Sapporo Shrine'.

attractions.name: Tanukikoji Shopping Arcade
attractions.description: Approximately 1 km-long arcade with around 200 shops.

attractions.name: Mt. Moiwa (cable car included)
attractions.description: One of Japan's 'New Three Great Night Views' and one of Sapporo's most iconic scenic spots. After sunset the city lights sparkle below; the summit observatory gives a 360-degree panorama of Sapporo.

attractions.name: Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum
attractions.description: The most magnificent ancient underground military museum in China, known as 'the eighth wonder of the world' and 'one of the great discoveries in the archaeological history of the 20th century'.

attractions.name: Bell and Drum Square
attractions.description: Located at the intersection of the four east, west, north and south streets. The Bell Tower (600+ years old) stands on the east side and the largest Drum Tower in the country on the west side.

attractions.name: Datang Everbright City
attractions.description: At the foot of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, themed on the Tang dynasty so visitors can experience Tang culture; a night-time highlight.

attractions.name: Mt. Hua
attractions.description: One of China's 'Five Great Mountains', known for the world's most dangerous hiking trail, scenic views and temples; a China National 5A tourist spot.

attractions.name: Longmen Grottoes
attractions.description: Houses tens of thousands of statues of Shakyamuni Buddha and his disciples, nearly 2,500 stelae and inscriptions ('Forest of Ancient Stelae') and over sixty Buddhist pagodas. 5A scenic area and UNESCO World Heritage Site.

attractions.name: Luoyi Ancient City
attractions.description: A place carrying thousands of years of history and culture where every brick and tile has a story.

attractions.name: Shaolin Temple
attractions.description: 5A tourist spot, famous Buddhist temple and the ancestral home of Chinese Zen Buddhism; Shaolin martial arts made its monks famous worldwide.

attractions.name: Ataturk Mausoleum
attractions.description: Mausoleum of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, leader of the Turkish War of Independence and first President of the Republic of Turkey. Also the resting place of İsmet İnönü, the second President (died 1973), whose tomb faces the mausoleum across the Ceremonial Ground.

attractions.name: Underground City
attractions.description: Underground cities likely built to withstand attack and protect large numbers of people and animals during crises.

attractions.name: Uchisar 'Castle' Village
attractions.description: At the highest point of Cappadocia; very hilly, so difficult for those with walking difficulties. A castle and one of the most magnificent views of the landscape are at the top.

attractions.name: Pigeon Valley
attractions.description: Named for the thousands of pigeon houses carved into soft tuff since ancient times; pigeons were a source of food and fertilizer.

attractions.name: Three Beauties (Uc Guzeller)
attractions.description: Icon of Cappadocia's natural beauty with the most famous fairy chimneys.

attractions.name: Ancient Caravanserai
attractions.description: A roadside inn where travelers rested; supported commerce and movement along Silk Road trade routes covering Asia, North Africa and southeastern Europe.

attractions.name: Cotton Castle
attractions.description: Famous for the white, cottony mineral bath terraces, rich in calcium; a 'spa town' since Roman times with warm therapeutic waters.

attractions.name: Ancient City of Hierapolis
attractions.description: Ancient city on hot springs in classical Phrygia, southwestern Anatolia; now an archaeological museum and UNESCO World Heritage Site.

attractions.name: Ephesus Ancient City
attractions.description: One of the world's most outstanding archaeological sites; walk its marble streets to the Library of Celsus, the Odeon, Grand Theatre, Temple of Hadrian, Roman Bath etc.

attractions.name: Trojan Horse
attractions.description: One of Canakkale's biggest attractions; the 'wooden horse' made famous by the movie Troy. Troy Museum excluded.

attractions.name: Blue Mosque
attractions.description: Sultan Ahmed Mosque, called the Blue Mosque for the blue tiles lining its interior; unique 6 minarets.

attractions.name: Hippodrome Square
attractions.description: Site of horse-carriage races and gladiator fights in the Byzantine Empire; now decorated with an Egyptian Column, Serpentine Column and Ibrahim Pasha Palace.

attractions.name: St. Sophia (Hagia Sophia)
attractions.description: Known as Hagia Sophia after the Ottomans captured Constantinople in 1453; one of the finest examples of Byzantine architecture. The brochure describes it as a museum.

attractions.name: Topkapi Palace
attractions.description: Residence of the Ottoman sultans and the administrative and educational centre of the state; now a large museum.

attractions.name: Grand Bazaar
attractions.description: One of the largest and oldest markets in the world, often regarded as one of the first shopping malls.

attractions.name: Bahnhofstrasse
attractions.description: Zurich's main downtown street and one of the world's most expensive and exclusive shopping avenues; in 2011 named the most expensive street for retail property in Europe (third worldwide), ninth in 2016.

attractions.name: Lindenhof Hill
attractions.description: A peaceful green oasis in the heart of Zurich with views over the Old Town, the Limmat River and historic landmarks; once a Roman fort and later a medieval stronghold, now a quiet park under linden trees.

attractions.name: Swiss National Museum
attractions.description: One of Europe's most important cultural history museums, in a fairytale-castle-like building, covering ancient artefacts, medieval art, traditional crafts and modern exhibits.

attractions.name: Fraumünster
attractions.description: (From the Chinese text) Reformed church founded in 853 by Louis the German for his daughter; known for its blue-topped spire and five stained-glass windows by Marc Chagall installed in 1970.

attractions.name: Mount Rigi
attractions.description: 'Queen of the Mountains', highest peak 1,797 m; 360-degree views of Lake Lucerne, the Swiss Alps and, on clear days, the Black Forest. Popular for hiking and photography.

attractions.name: Chapel Bridge
attractions.description: Built in the 14th century; covered roof decorated with 17th-century paintings of Swiss history and mythology.

attractions.name: Lion Monument
attractions.description: Carved into a sandstone cliff: a dying lion on a shield bearing the Swiss coat of arms, pierced by a spear and surrounded by broken weapons.

attractions.name: Bärengraben (Bear Pit)
attractions.description: A recreation area at the lower end of Bern's old town, open around the clock and free; brown bears have lived in the enclosure on the banks of the Aare since 2009.

attractions.name: Chillon Castle
attractions.description: Island castle on Lake Geneva at the eastern end of the lake between Montreux and Villeneuve; among the most visited medieval castles in Europe. Held by the House of Savoy, then Bernese from 1536 to 1798; now a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance.
